_readme: HOMEPAGE COVER DECK - the photographs behind the masthead statement.
HOW TO EDIT, easiest first:
1. IN EDIT MODE, ON THE SITE. Turn on Edit mode (bottom-left toggle),
then right-click any cover photograph and choose 'Replace image'.
Rotation pauses automatically while edit mode is on, and the arrows
and dots stay visible, so step to the slide you want and replace it.
A published replacement wins over this file, applies live, and is
baked into the next deploy. Nothing here needs changing for that.
2. IN THIS FILE, to add, remove or reorder slides. Edit the 'slides'
array and rebuild. Order here is the order on screen.
FIELDS
id - stable, unique, kebab-case. The build fails on duplicates.
Keep the id when you swap a photo for the same subject; the
id is what the CMS slot is remembered against.
src - path under next/public. WebP, about 2400px wide, under 400KB.
alt - plain description for screen readers and search. Always fill.
focal - optional object-position. The statement sits lower-left, so
bias upward ('center 30%') on photographs with a busy or
bright bottom edge. Defaults to 'center 38%'.
RULES
• Slide 1 is the LCP image: keep the lightest, calmest frame first.
• 3 to 5 slides. More is weight the reader never sees.
• An empty array falls back to the single default cover photograph.
• Turn the whole slideshow off with SHOW_HOME_COVER_SLIDESHOW in
src/lib/features.ts - slide 1 then renders exactly as it did before.
The per-slide CMS slots are cover.image (slide 1), cover.image.2,
cover.image.3 … in order. Slide 1 keeps the original slot name so any
replacement published before the slideshow landed still applies.
